parsed_response.reasoning: In packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts the diff changes `const key = googleCredentialSchema.parse(googleCredentials)` to `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema)`, and parseRefreshTokenResponse (new file) returns `schema.safeParse(...)`'s full result object, not `.data`. That wrapper ({success, data, error}) is then written to `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`, so the stored credential is the zod wrapper instead of the credentials — breaking subsequent loads. This happens regardless of whether credential sharing is enabled, since the function always returns the safeParse result.

judged_text: Google Calendar CalendarService stores the entire zod safeParse wrapper object ({success, data, error}) in credential.key instead of the parsed data, breaking Google Calendar after the first token refresh even when credential sharing is disabled
